plain: This story is about the ancient monuments of Egypt, especially the Great Sphinx, and the idea that marks on the stone show water damage. A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that two researchers, John Anthony West and Robert Schoch, think the monuments were built much earlier than usually believed because of this water damage. A researcher of ancient catastrophes named Randall Carlson tells it from his own study, saying he is convinced the marks are water erosion. Carlson points to the enclosure around the Sphinx, credits the earlier scholar Schwaller de Lubicz as well as West, and puts the work at about 12,000 years ago. So it comes from a host repeating others and from a researcher giving his own view. If true, it would mean a forgotten civilisation built these monuments long before the Egypt we know.
